output.explanation: The signed 2026 Renewal Order Form, effective 2026-04-01 and running to 2027-03-31, sets a 10% discount (USD 1,920 discounted to USD 1,728 per seat per year), so it governs on May 1, 2026. The 12% figure in the informal April 9 debrief note reflects the pre-renewal rate from the December 2025 email and is overridden by the signed contract terms.
